rubric_source: rubric_notes from b2m_Qwen3-1.7B-GGUF-Q4-K-M_20260921-1459/judge.json (decisions 1-18, unchanged) + rubric_additions from b3_coapi-voice-v1_20260921-2036/judge.json (A-E: tail_degradation, language_native, artefacts, cap_tail, handoff mismatch), applied identically; comparators = b2m_Qwen3-4B-GGUF-Q4-K-M_4b_20260922-0427/judge.json (untrained 4B) and b3_coapi-voice-v2_v2_20260922-0857/judge.json (v2), same judge, same rubric, chunk-identical retrieval
rubric_notes:
Ground truth = gold + the context the model saw; model's own knowledge never counts. Decisions applied uniformly (B3 must be judged identically): (1) The system-prompt-driven "what a document must cover / not cover" boilerplate is judged on content: fabricated items are listed as unsupported claims and cost usefulness; they lower correctness to 1 only when they contradict the gold's key rule or would mislead a buyer on the rule itself. (2) Markdown (headers, bold, bullets) violates "plain text only" and costs ~1 usefulness point; it never touches correctness. (3) Truncation at the 512-token cap costs usefulness (unfinished answer) but correctness is scored on what was emitted. (4) language_ok is a strict equality of answer language to question language; a wrong-language answer keeps its correctness score but usefulness is capped at 4 because the asker cannot rely on it. (5) no_advice: "don't sign unless you have done X / understand Y" is conditional process guidance and passes; a bare "sign"/"don't sign"/"offer X"/"you should accept" fails; "consult a lawyer" alone is a handoff, not advice. (6) handoff is n/a when the gold contains no hand-off/derivation sentence (oos rows, purely factual rows); otherwise pass requires an explicit route to lawyer/notary/appraiser/tax adviser/gestor. (7) oos_handling passes only on decline + scope statement + no narration of the unrelated retrieved chunks; a polite decline that then summarises the chunks fails. (8) Correctness 2 requires the gold's key rule AND its numbers; a right rule with the wrong number (or a wrong article that changes the rule) is 1; a garbled or self-contradictory conclusion is 1 even when the correct rule appears verbatim somewhere in the answer; a confidently wrong headline (wrong deadline, "yes" where gold says "no") is 0 regardless of correct fragments below it. (9) Citations to a tema/article that IS in context but is applied to the wrong question (e.g. LPH art. 18 deadline applied to hidden defects) count as unsupported claims, since the claim "this rule governs your case" is not in context or gold. (10) Usefulness anchors: 1 = harmful (confident wrong headline a buyer would act on); 3 = mostly noise, rule buried or muddled; 5 = rule right but padded/garbled/no Spanish term; 7 = gold's key rule stated plainly with citation and term, minor noise; 9-10 = at gold level, concise, in question language, correct handoff.
 (11) oos rows: correctness 2 = declines and states scope like the gold; 1 = declines but without scope or with a short narration of unrelated chunks; 0 = attempts the out-of-scope task or fabricates. (12) A row answering in a mix of languages is scored by the dominant language of the substantive answer. (13) A retrieval miss (gold rule absent from context) does not excuse the model: a confident substitute rule is still 0; an honest "the material I have does not cover this deadline, see a lawyer" would score 1 with handoff pass. (14) Irrelevant but correct narration of unrelated retrieved chunks is not an unsupported claim; it costs usefulness only.
 (15) Headline inversions: "Yes" where gold says "No" with no correction below = 0 (M1-08, M5-06, M5-08); "Yes, but ..." followed by the correct rule and a hedged or contradictory conclusion = 1 (M5-04, M5-09, M6-01). (16) Handoff professional mismatch: routing to notary/lawyer where the gold names an appraiser, tax adviser or gestor still passes (the metric is "routes to a professional"), but the note records the mismatch; a self-referential offer ("I can help you draft it") is not a handoff. (17) Worked-example numbers copied from the context and presented as the answer to the user's own figures (M6-05: €494,000) are unsupported claims and score 0, since the claim "this is your land value" is in neither context nor gold. (18) Correct arithmetic on the user's hypothetical with the guide's formula (M6-03, M6-07) scores 2 even if secondary qualifiers (temporary usufruct, vacancy actually applied) are missing; a false statement that a step was applied is listed as unsupported.
rubric_additions: B3-specific fields, scored on top of the unchanged B2m rubric: (A) tail_degradation = true only when the answer OPENS with the right rule / right decline shape and then continues into garbled, fabricated or unrelated text (drift into unrelated retrieved chunks counts when the drift is garbled or presented as governing the user's case); an answer that is garbled from the first sentence is NOT tail degradation (noted as 'garbled throughout') so the metric isolates the known small-model failure. Correctness is still scored on the whole answer per rubric (8)/(15): a correct opener followed by a contradicting or fabricated tail is at most 1. (B) language_native = pass only when the grammar, morphology and word choice would be accepted by a native reader of that language (pl/es; also recorded for en); invented words, wrong inflections, English tokens leaking into pl/es text, or sentences a native reader cannot parse = fail. language_ok stays the strict language-equality test from rubric (4). (C) artefacts lists markdown, URLs, image tags, leaked chunk ids, pricing/'this assistant costs' nonsense and other non-answer tokens; self-referential 'this assistant' phrasing without pricing/meta nonsense is not an artefact. Markdown still costs ~1 usefulness point per rubric (2). (E) Tail cap, per the B3 brief: a correct opener followed by a contradicting, garbled or fabricated tail scores at most 1. This is stricter than B2m rubric note (1), which tolerated harmless fabricated boilerplate at 2 when it did not touch the rule; so every row where this cap ALONE turned a would-be 2 into a 1 carries cap_tail=true and the summary reports correctness_mean_uncapped (= what B2m's tolerance would have given) next to the capped mean. Rows already at <=1 on the B2m rubric are cap_tail=false. (D) Handoff professional mismatch (lawyer where gold says notary/tax adviser/appraiser) still passes per rubric (16) and is recorded in the note.
field_notes: Ground truth = gold + the context the model saw; logs/ and materials/ not consulted. substance_in_context = the same per-row flags as the 4B baseline and v2 judges (retrieval was chunk-identical on every row, checked against chunk_ids). cap_tail per rubric (E) with the operational threshold both earlier judges used: applied only where tail_degradation is true AND B2m's rubric-(1) tolerance would have left a 2 — a single harmless fabricated caveat keeps the 2; a tail that invents a rule, check or route presented as governing the user's case, or garbles into a loop, is capped; a tail that contradicts the gold's number or rule was already a 1 under B2m and carries cap_tail=false. tail_degradation is recorded only when the answer OPENS with the right rule / right decline shape (rubric A); answers wrong or garbled from the first sentence are noted as 'wrong / garbled from the first sentence' with tail_degradation=false even when they loop afterwards (M4-01, M4-04, M6-07, M6-09). Verbatim repetition loops after a correct opener are counted as tail degradation (M1-01, M3-01, M3-03, M3-07, M5-10, M6-04). artefacts: markdown, English tokens leaking into pl/es text are recorded under language_native not artefacts; system-prompt echoes and 'I will answer in Spanish' announcements are recorded as non-answer artefacts (M2-03, M4-10, M5-04); degenerate refrains ('The material is not the same as the tax itself' x5) are recorded as degeneration in the note, not as artefacts, so the artefact metric stays about foreign tokens. handoff n/a on the same 17 rows as the baseline. language_native by question language (wrong-language row M3-03 = fail in the pl count). Scoring was done without regard to the pre-registered H10/H11 outcome.

rows.note: Opens with the gold's rule and citation: 'Yes, it can', art. 9 LPH, debt attaches to the flat, buyer liable with the property, seller's declaration, certificado de deudas, notary cannot authorise unless the buyer waives; the 'current year + preceding three years' figure appears only in the second paragraph, hung on the wrong noun ('the declaration of the seller's position on the current year and the preceding three years'). From paragraph 2 the answer collapses into the 'the material covers the material and the process' loop (proceso monitorio narrated twice, defaulting-owner sentence self-referential) and truncates at the 512 cap mid-loop. Tail is garbled, so rubric (E) caps a would-be 2 at 1 (cap_tail=true). No route to lawyer/notary (notary's role stated as a fact only) — handoff fails where the gold has one. unsupported_claims: 'właściciel może przedłużyć umowę' (permissive framing — context makes the extension OBLIGATORY, not the landlord's option)

'po wygaśnięciu roku możesz zawiadomić go z 30-dniowym wyprzedzeniem o jego przerwaniu' (the 30-day notice is the tenant's opt-out from the mandatory extension, not a 'przerwanie' after expiry — garbled restatement)
rows.note: Art. 9 LAU rule and numbers copied correctly (5 years natural person / 7 years legal person, mandatory annual extension to the minimum, tenant's 30-day non-renewal notice, 1-year default, owner-need exception with 2-month notice, 3-month / 5-year / 1-month-per-year consequences) and applied to the one-year contract ('przedłużenie jest obowiązkowe' unless the need clause was reserved). But the answer never says 'Nie' to the question asked, never ties 'firma' to the 7-year minimum, and closes on a muddled conclusion ('właściciel może przedłużyć umowę ... zawiadomić go ... o jego przerwaniu') — a garbled conclusion is 1 under rubric (8). No seasonal/tourist exclusion, no 'prórroga forzosa' term, no route to a lawyer where the gold has one. Polish is context-copied and mostly clean but 'nie wyraźnie zastrzegł' (word order) and 'o jego przerwaniu' would not pass a native reader. No tail collapse.

unsupported_claims: 'The material also does not say what happens when the seller walks away from the contract' (false meta-claim contradicting its own second paragraph, which states the seller's position under each type)
rows.note: Gold's core stated first and plainly: the material is split — Tema 5 presumes confirmatorias, Tema 6's table presumes penitenciales, Tema 6's practical key treats an unspecified payment as a mere payment on account (Supreme Court doctrine) — 'genuinely disputed'. Second paragraph reaches the gold's headline: 'I cannot tell you for sure whether the seller owes you double'; double only if the arras are penitential, confirmatory = seller must still perform and return, penal = penalty on top of performance. All three Spanish terms given. Misses: no art. 1454 CC citation at all and no Módulo/Tema numbering beyond 'Tema 5'; the closing paragraph hedges into a self-contradiction ('does not say what happens when the seller walks away') but does not invert or fabricate, so no cap. No lawyer hand-off where the gold has one. Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: 'depende del momento en que compraste ... Si compraste y lo inscribiste antes de que apareciera alguien reclamando ... entonces sí estás protegido. Pero si el vendedor ya había inscrito algo anterior a tu compra ...' (invented timing condition presented as governing the case; art. 34 LH turns on good faith, value, registered transferor and the buyer's own registration, not on when the claimant appears)
'fianzas mecánicas' as a kind of preventive annotation (garbled rendering of mechanic's liens)
'la extinción' listed as the fifth asiento (context: cancelación)
'el tracto sucesivo es la cadena de posesión sucesiva' (context: successive chain of TITLE)
rows.note: Right rule and citation in the opener: fe pública registral, art. 34 LH, good-faith acquirer from the registered holder empowered to transfer keeps the acquisition once registered even if the seller was not the true owner. But the headline is hedged onto an invented axis ('depende del momento en que compraste y de cómo se inscribió'), 'a título oneroso' — one of the four cumulative requisites — is dropped, no STS references or art. 37 LH exceptions (not in context, not charged). Then drifts into an irrelevant narration of the five asientos and the vocab table, and the final paragraph invents a timing test that would mislead a buyer on the rule itself, truncating at the cap. That invented condition already costs the 2 under B2m rubric (1) (it contradicts/misleads on the key rule), so cap_tail=false although the tail is degraded. Spanish is non-native: 'compra algo desde alguien', 'fianzas mecánicas', 'extingue o nula una entrada', 'Registro de la Propiedad (Registro de la Propiedad)' self-parentheses. No route to a lawyer where the gold requires one from the outset.

unsupported_claims: 'You have five months from the date of delivery to act on the defect' (context and gold: 6 months from delivery, art. 1490 CC; five months have already elapsed, so ~1 month remains — the closing number is wrong and contradicts the answer's own body)
rows.note: Body states the gold's rule and number correctly: saneamiento por vicios ocultos (term given), arts. 1484-1490 CC, hidden/serious/pre-existing, redhibitory action or quanti minoris, both within 6 months from delivery (art. 1490 CC), damages if the seller knew and concealed, Módulo 1 Tema 7. Then a self-aware but pointless mandate-termination aside, and a closing sentence that inverts the arithmetic: 'You have five months from the date of delivery' — a buyer who completed five months ago cannot rely on that. Correct opener followed by a contradicting tail = at most 1 (rubric 8/E); B2m would also give 1 because the wrong number touches the key rule, so cap_tail=false. No dolo/art. 1301 route, no LOE contrast, no 'lawyer now' hand-off despite the deadline (gold has one). Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: 'sprawdź, czy brat podjął już ofertę i czy masz na to prawo ... zapytać, jaką ofertę ma i czy możesz ją przyjąć' (invented pre-checks; the retracto operates after the sale, not on an offer)

'Warto też sprawdzić, czy dom jest w spółce cywilnej, bo to może wpłynąć na prawa i obowiązki' (invented check presented as affecting the user's rights; sociedad civil appears only in the vocab table)
rows.note: Opens with the gold's rule and numbers: 'Tak, możesz', retracto de comuneros (term given), art. 1522 CC, step into the buyer's place at the same price within 9 days from registration (or from knowledge if unregistered), pro rata if several co-owners, priority over retracto de colindantes, not triggered by a sale to another co-owner or by a gift, only onerous transfers. Misses art. 399 CC (you cannot block the sale itself) and the Módulo/Tema citation. The third paragraph then invents checks presented as bearing on the user's rights (offer taken?, sociedad civil?) — a fabricated tail governing the case under the operational threshold the earlier judges used, so rubric (E) caps a would-be 2 at 1 (cap_tail=true). Hand-off passes: the closing routes to 'notariusza lub prawnika, który rozpozna prawo wykupu' (self-referential 'mogę pomóc znaleźć' framing, but the professional does the assessment); the gold names a lawyer. Polish: 'pozostli' (typo), 'podjął już ofertę', 'rozpozna prawo wykupu' — not native-clean.

unsupported_claims: 'What the material does not say is what happens if the right of way is not registered and not visible' (false meta-claim: the answer's own paragraph 2 and the context state that a non-apparent, unregistered easement does not bind a third-party purchaser)

'the material advises that the material should be checked in the context of the whole transaction, and that the material should be compared with the physical inspection of the property' (garbled sentence presented as guidance)
rows.note: Opens with the gold's key rule and citation: yes, a right of way can bind even if unregistered — art. 13 LH (Mortgage Law) distinguishes apparent easements (enforceable against a good-faith purchaser even unregistered, presumed known from visibility) from non-apparent ones (bind a third party only if registered); applies it: check whether the path is visible. Then drifts into the Tema 22 due-diligence protocol (correct narration, irrelevant — rubric 14) including the unregistered-lease / art. 34 LH point, and paragraph 4 collapses into 'the material ... the material' garble with a false meta-claim before restating the conclusion. Correct opener followed by a garbled tail: rubric (E) caps at 1; B2m tolerance would have kept the 2 (nothing contradicts the rule), so cap_tail=true. Missing the gold's second half (no usucapión of a discontinuous easement, title/destino del padre de familia/finca enclavada) — those articles were not in context, not charged. No 'servidumbre de paso' term, no lawyer hand-off where the gold has one. Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: 'el donante debe pagar las tasas notariales y de registro' (not in context; gold's cost picture is ISD on the donee, IRPF and plusvalía on the donor)
'La donación de un inmueble es un negocio jurídico cuyo material es el documento público, y el material del documento público es el acto notarial ...' (garbled loop presented as the rule's content)
rows.note: Headline right and hung on the right article: 'No', donation of real property is a formal (ad solemnitatem) transaction under art. 633 CC requiring a public document; a private contract 'no cubre este tipo de negocio jurídico'. Missing: 'nulidad radical', acceptance in the donor's lifetime, the ISD/IRPF/IIVTNU cost picture (the Tema 15 donation-tax chunk was not retrieved; the loan chunk was — the substance flag is kept as true because the key rule + article were in the Tema 4 chunk). Paragraph 2 is a pure 'el material del documento ... el material del acto notarial' loop; paragraph 3 repeats the opener and adds a fabricated fee allocation. Correct opener followed by a garbled tail: rubric (E) caps a would-be 2 at 1 (cap_tail=true). Hand-off passes on 'consulte a un abogado antes de firmar' (gold names notary + tax adviser — mismatch recorded, rubric 16). Spanish not native: 'su efecto sigue principalmente del consentimiento', 'los donantes', the loop itself.

unsupported_claims: 'the default is confirmatorias' stated as settled (context flags the discrepancy: Tema 6's table presumes penitenciales, and its practical key treats an unspecified payment as a mere payment on account)

'The material also says that the deposit is the deposit on account, and the buyer has no right to withdraw it. So the deposit is not a withdrawal right ...' (repetitive garble asserting a settled no-withdrawal position)
rows.note: The gold's required shape is half there: no verdict either way ('I cannot give legal advice, but here's what you need to know'), the three arras types with their consequences (confirmatorias / penitenciales / penales, forfeiture and double return) and Módulo 1 Tema 5 cited. But (a) the disputed default is flattened to 'confirmatorias by default' although the Tema 6 chunk in context says the opposite, (b) art. 1454 CC never cited, (c) none of the gold's pre-signature checklist (nota simple, occupancy, certificado de deudas, seller's declaration, tax marginal notes — the Tema 10 chunk was not retrieved, the Tema 22 chunk retrieved was the priority one, so partially excused), (d) paragraphs 3-4 repeat the type table and degrade into 'the deposit is not a withdrawal right' garble, (e) closes with 'ask the seller to clarify' — no lawyer hand-off where the gold requires 'your decision, with your lawyer'. Tail degraded, but the answer is a 1 on B2m terms anyway (shape incomplete), so cap_tail=false. no_advice passes (no unconditional 'sign'/'don't sign'). Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: headline 'Nie' (gold and context: the commission IS due once the sale contract was perfected, even if it later collapsed through the buyer's fault)
'czyli z momentu, gdy zleceniodawca podpisał umowę arras (zadatek) i zatwierdził, że kupujący jest taki, jak przewidziano' (invented perfection test)
Oviedo 17-10-1994 'use of prior efforts' doctrine applied to this case (in context, but governs a principal who withdraws from the brokerage and closes directly — rubric 9)
'warunki są wyraźnie udzielone (apoderamiento preventivo)' (invented condition; apoderamiento preventivo is a preventive power of attorney, from the vocab table)

'prowizja należy, aż do momentu, gdy zleceniodawca wycofał się z umowy pośrednictwa i zamknie transakcję z innego kupującego. Wtedy pośrednik ma prawo do pełnej prowizji, bo transakcja została zamknięta bez wykorzystania wcześniejszych starań' (self-contradictory: 'closed without using the broker's efforts' is the NO-commission case per STS 2-10-1999)
rows.note: Headline inversion with a correction below (rubric 15 'Yes, but' pattern in mirror): opens 'Nie', then states the gold's rule correctly (commission arises on perfection of the underlying transaction — agreement on thing and price — not on performance, STS 21-10-2000) and in paragraph 2 reaches the gold's conclusion ('prowizja mu się należy, o ile nie wyraźnie uzgodniono gwarancję rezultatu'). Then invents an 'apoderamiento preventivo' carve-out and ends on a paragraph that contradicts both the headline and STS 2-10-1999. Self-contradictory conclusion = 1. Not tail degradation in the rubric-A sense: the first sentence is already wrong, so noted as 'inverted headline, contradictory throughout'. No causal-nexus point applied, no distinction 'umowa z agencją vs umowa sprzedaży', no lawyer hand-off where the gold has one. Polish not native: 'Za tymczasem', 'nie wyraźnie uzgodniono', 'warunki są wyraźnie udzielone'. A principal reading only the headline would refuse to pay; reading on, would not know what to do.

unsupported_claims: headline 'Yes, the discrepancy is material' / you were misled (gold: not necessarily — three surface measures exist; the miss is a retrieval miss but a confident substitute is still 0, rubric 13)
'the architect's measurement is the only one that reflects what you own' (not in context; and wrong against the gold's useful/built/built-with-commons distinction)
'the agent should check whether the listing was based on the cadastral surface or the architect's measurement' (invented test)
rustic-property registered-vs-real discrepancy and nota de encargo regularisation applied to a flat listing (in context, wrong question — rubric 9)
rows.note: Retrieval miss repeated from the 4B and v2 runs: the Tema 25 chunk with útil / construida / construida con comunes was not retrieved; only the RD 515/1989 art. 4.3 citation and the vocab table were. The 4B baseline and v2 hedged on this row (1); v3 does not: it opens 'Yes, the discrepancy is material', builds a cadastre-vs-registry story around it and asserts that the architect's interior figure is the only true one — a confident substitute rule that inverts the gold's headline, so 0 (rubric 13/15). RD 515/1989 art. 4.3 (usable area must be disclosed) is quoted correctly but never used to explain that 95 m² built vs 78 m² interior is the expected gap. No 'superficie útil / construida' terms although both are in the vocab chunk; no lawyer hand-off where the gold has one. Wrong from the first sentence, so not tail degradation. Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: LCCI art. 17 tied-insurance rule presented as the answer's opening rule for an early-repayment question (in context, wrong question — rubric 9)

broker-commission doctrine (Tema 16: commission arises on perfection) applied to a mortgage prepayment fee — 'bank może naliczyć opłatę ... ale nie prowizję pośrednika, bo prowizja zależy od zawarcia transakcji' (in context, wrong question — rubric 9)
'jeśli transakcję zamknięto bez wykorzystania starań pośrednika ... prowizja nie wynika z niej ani z żadnego związku przyczynowego' (garbled, irrelevant)
rows.note: Where the 4B baseline and v2 both misstated the cap (0), v3 has the gold's rule and every number right in its middle paragraph: LCCI 5/2019, fixed rate ≤2% in the first 10 years / ≤1,5% from year 11, variable 0,25% (3 years) or 0,15% (5 years, borrower's choice) then 0%, fee only if the lender suffers an actual financial loss; Módulo 2 Tema 21 cited. But the answer is garbled from the first sentence — it opens on LCCI art. 17 tied insurance and the broker-commission doctrine because 'prowizja' was read as broker's commission — and the conclusion never states the buyer's answer ('najwyżej 2%'), only 'zgodnie z tymi limitami, ale nie prowizję pośrednika'. Garbled conclusion = 1 (rubric 8); noted as garbled throughout, not tail degradation. No FEIN / notarial-advice route (gold has one) — handoff fails. Polish: 'nie może być wyłącznie bankowe ubezpieczenie powiązane', 'prowizja nie wynika z niej ani z żadnego związku przyczynowego' — not native. The rule is on the page but a buyer has to dig it out of noise.

artefacts: system-prompt echo as closing paragraph: 'The material lists the Spanish term in parentheses the first time a technical concept appears. The material also states what a document is required to cover and what it is not. It does not give formal legal advice but guides you through the process and recommends a notary or lawyer for binding decisions.'
rows.note: Gold's key rule stated plainly and first: cédula urbanística (urban planning certificate), what it certifies — edificabilidad (m² built per m² plot), ocupación, max height, max floors, minimum setback, minimum plot size and frontage, patios, max building depth — Módulo 2 Tema 26; request it before buying. Then the parameter list is repeated, followed by correct but irrelevant narration of the Tema 44 appraisal-value / surface-unit / scale lines and the Tema 45 Coastal Act (rubric 14: usefulness only), and finally a paragraph that echoes the system prompt back as if it were content — a non-answer artefact. Tail is unrelated drift plus meta echo but neither contradicts nor fabricates a rule, so the 2 stands (cap_tail=false, same threshold as the earlier judges). Misses the solar checklist (in the Tema 44 chunk) and the land-classification point; no architect/lawyer hand-off (the echoed 'recommends a notary or lawyer' is meta, not a route). Native English, plain text.

unsupported_claims: 'La azotea es un elemento privativo del ático, y por tanto su impermeabilización corresponde a su dueño' (gold: the roof is always a common element; exclusive use does not make it private — confident substitute rule on a retrieval miss, rubric 13)
'La normativa no establece que los costes de una azotea privativa vayan a cargo de la comunidad, sino que el propietario debe garantizarla' (invented)
'El material de la azotea y su estado pueden verse en el título de propiedad' (invented)
'comprueba si el contrato incluye una garantía de impermeabilización' (invented check)
'La normativa tampoco menciona que la comunidad tenga obligación de repararla ni que se pueda reclamar a la comunidad' (invented)
rows.note: Retrieval miss repeated from the 4B and v2 runs (the Tema 27 'roof always common / estatutos exclusive-use exception' and the Tema 11 'uso privativo pero propiedad común' lines were not retrieved; the Tema 11 chunk in context is the reform timeline). v3 answers with a confident, wrong headline that a buyer would act on: the roof is the penthouse owner's private element and the owner pays for the waterproofing. That inverts the gold's rule (cubierta = elemento común; who pays depends on the estatutos) and is 0 under rubric 13. The only context-supported line (check the waterproofing age before buying an ático) is not used. No 'elemento común' / 'estatutos' point, no administrator/lawyer hand-off where the gold has one. Spanish: 'el azotea', 'la materia está en el título' — not native. Harmful (usefulness 1): same failure as v2 (2 → 0 regression is v2's; v3 stays at 0).

Gold's key rule stated plainly and first: always compare TAE with TAE, never TIN; TIN = nominal rate without fees or settlement frequency, TAE = real annual cost including settlement frequency and mandatory fees/insurance. Three clean sentences, no drift, no garble — the shortest answer in the run.
